findings.claim: In the local sim on champion B80 (28c3acc, seeds 1000-1191, 192 games), 76 games (39.6%) hold a laser by 30 s. Of the other 116: 51 never see or remember a laser by 30 s, 7 die before 30 s without ever seeing one, and 9 run the rush but do not arrive by 30 s. The remaining 49 know a laser within the 250 m trip limit but the rush is blocked. In 41 of those 49 games, the ONLY thing blocking it on some ticks is 'a mech hit us in the last 3 s' (the FARM_QUIET_S gate on the B17 rush). It is the sole blocker on 4,314 decision ticks, against 496 for claim-cubes, 393 for engage, 373 for no free slot and 109 for cube-first. On those ticks the laser's median distance is 75 m, and 63% are within 100 m. These 49 blocked games score 2.55 on average, and 26 of them die before 40 s.

sources.quote: in the games where we do not have a laser by 30 s, what stopped B17's rush?

findings.suggested_change: Build (Lane B, one flag UNDER_FIRE_RUSH_M = 100): in the first 30 s, let the B17 rush start or continue while being hit, but only toward a LASER (never lightning or mortar) within UNDER_FIRE_RUSH_M. Every other gate stays: not hurt (HP at or above retreatHp), not engaging, no cube claim, free slot, zone-safe, LASER_TRIP_M and LASER_CHASE_S. In brain.ts at the rush gate, replace `obs.t - lastMechHit > FARM_QUIET_S` with `(quiet || ufLaser)`, where ufLaser = t < 30 and a known laser is within UNDER_FIRE_RUSH_M. In the options filter, when !quiet, keep only lasers within that distance. Same-seed what-if (192 games) at 120 m: laser by 30 s 76 -> 94, laser at end 95 -> 111, gun-only at end 71 -> 57, died<40 s 51 -> 47, sim score -0.016 +/- 0.119 (46/192 changed). At 80 m: laser by 30 s 76 -> 91, gun-only at end 71 -> 60, died<40 s 51 -> 50, sim +0.016 +/- 0.096 (34/192 changed).
findings.mechanism: Showdown winners walk to a laser with an enemy inside 160 m (research-doug-0040). Our rush cancels on any mech hit for 3 s, so a poke at 20-30 s leaves us gun-only next to the laser. On the site, laser share (r=0.46) and gun-only share (r=-0.39) track the score better than the sim's mean (r=0.22), per coord/research/site-corr-2026-11-21.txt. This change moves both of those the right way without raising died<40 s. It differs from B76 (laser only, no specials), B39 (no boost), B36/B40 (does not outrank engage or finish) and B98 (does not touch engage).
